data.name: UpdatesPrivacy
data.value: PowerTrove checks GitHub for new versions at startup. You can turn this off above. GitHub receives ordinary connection metadata, never selected content. Update now downloads the installer, verifies its SHA-256 digest and closes PowerTrove for the update, then restarts it. For ZIP builds, the current folder becomes a registered installation. Windows security prompts remain enabled.

data.name: RecipeMixedForEmailDescription
data.value: Resizes images to max 1600 px, compresses PDFs, and zips the result.

data.value: Add “Open in PowerTrove” for a single local file. On Windows 11, look under “Show more options”. For multiple files, use the global shortcut.
